FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, SECTOR-25, CHANDIGARH
No.6673/UIET Dated:3/9/2026
ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE POST OF GUEST FACULTY
Applications are invited for the appointment of Guest Faculty in the University Institute of Engineering and
Technology to teach B.E. and M.E. classes for the Odd Semester of the academic session 2026-2027.
Sr.
No.
Name of the
Branch
Qualifications
1. Biotechnology
Post – 01
i. First Class B.E./B.Tech. in Biotechnology/Biochemical Engineering.
ii. First Class M.E./M.Tech. in Biotechnology/Biochemical Engineering or in relevant field of
Engineering.
iii. Without prejudice to the above, the following conditions may be considered desirable:
a) PhD completed/thesis submitted in Biotechnology Engineering or equivalent.
b) Teaching, research industrial and /or Professional experience in a reputed organization:
c) Research papers published in reputed, peer – reviewed journals.
2 Electrical and
Electronics
Engineering
Post- 01
i. First Class B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering or
equivalent.
ii. First Class M.E./M.Tech. in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering or
in relevant field of Engineering.
iii Without prejudice to the above, the following conditions may be considered desirable:
a) PhD completed/thesis submitted in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics
Engineering or equivalent.
b) Teaching, research industrial and /or Professional experience in a reputed organization.
c) Papers presented at Conferences and /or in refereed journals.
3. Mechanical
Engineering
Posts - 02
i. First Class BE/ B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
ii. First Class ME/ M. Tech in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.
iii. Without prejudice to the above, following conditions may be consider as desirable:-
a) PhD completed/thesis submitted in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.
b) Teaching, research, industrial and/ or professional experience in a reputed organisation.
c) Papers published in referred journals.
d) Papers presented at Conferences.
Honorarium:
The appointment of Guest Faculty is on lecture basis with token honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture subject to
the ceiling of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw
any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency and will do the same till they are teaching in
UIET as Guest Faculty.
Instructions for applicants:
1. The application form for the post of Assistant Professor is available at the website
https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf
2. The applications must reach the office of the Director, UIET by 14.09.2026.
3. The interview for the positions shall be held tentatively in the same week. The eligible candidates
shall be intimated about the exact date and time of the interview by phone.
4. All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant documents for
verification at the time of interview.
5. No TA/DA will be paid for interview
Sd/-
Director, UIET
